name: Collection — showcases motorcycle lineup with interactive tabs and dynamic specifications
description: Verifies that the Choose Your Ride / Collection section renders motorcycle tabs, updates images and specifications on tab selection.

planSteps.description: Navigate to / and scroll into the '#choose-your-ride' section
The section heading 'CHOOSE YOUR RIDE.' and category eyebrow 'ROYAL ENFIELD / COLLECTION' are visible
Numbered model tab buttons (01 CLASSIC 350 through 06 CLASSIC 350 SIGNALS) are rendered
The active motorcycle image, model title, and 4-column specifications grid are visible
The main title transitions to 'HIMALAYAN 450' and the category badge shows 'ADVENTURE TOURER'
The specifications grid updates to display Himalayan 450 specs (e.g. 452 CC displacement, 40.0 BHP power)
